description:
Whether FEMA puts a Twin Cities property, or the parcels around it, in the floodplain: the Special Flood Hazard Area or the 0.2% annual-chance band. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Is 100 Main St SE, Minneapolis in a flood zone?"
- "Which parcels near this address are in the floodplain?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: sfha: Special Flood Hazard Area; shaded: the 0.2% band only; all: every parcel FEMA flagged. Default sfha.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: flood_zone_check
title: Flood Zone Check
